subtitles.chinese: 磁吸拼装机器人，随盒附有基础玩法图册。
subtitles.english: Each magnetic robot comes with a booklet of basic activities.

subtitles.chinese: 不少孩子在试玩时发现了新花样，图册还来不及收录。
subtitles.english: Children at our demonstration counter have already found ways to play that haven't made it into the booklet yet.

subtitles.chinese: 周末欢迎到玩具专柜，亲自试试。
subtitles.english: Come and try one this weekend.

subtitles.chinese: 柜台旁还会展出往期试玩照片。
subtitles.english: Photos from earlier demonstrations will also be on display beside the counter.

subtitles.chinese: 远距连接组请留存本轮测试记录。
subtitles.english: Long-range connection staff should retain the latest test records.

subtitles.chinese: 顶部防护板新增了几处碰痕，回收的样机头身连接正常。
subtitles.english: Fresh impact marks have been found on the overhead guard, although the recovered unit's head-to-body joints are intact.

subtitles.chinese: 同批样机此前均已通过常规检查。
subtitles.english: All units in this batch had previously passed their routine checks.

subtitles.chinese: 检修前，请保持工位原样。
subtitles.english: Leave the station as it is until maintenance arrives.

subtitles.chinese: 拆下的头部请放入周转盘，禁止抛掷。
subtitles.english: Detached heads must be placed in the parts tray, not thrown.

subtitles.chinese: 本周已有数台样机被落下的头部击中，跌下承载平台。
subtitles.english: Several units struck by falling heads have dropped off their support platforms this week.

subtitles.chinese: 受损外壳请单独送检，不要混回待包装区。
subtitles.english: Send damaged casings for inspection rather than returning them to the packing area.

subtitles.chinese: 损失将计入对应班组。
subtitles.english: The resulting losses will be charged to the responsible shift.

subtitles.chinese: 多台机器人在无人操作时返回各自测试区的起点，引发关于自主意识的讨论。
subtitles.english: Reports of robots returning unprompted to the starting points in their test areas have renewed debate over possible self-awareness.

subtitles.chinese: 部分样机此前曾跌离测试路线。
subtitles.english: Some had previously fallen from the test course.

subtitles.chinese: 沿途监控却没有记录到返回过程。
subtitles.english: Cameras along the route recorded no return journey.

subtitles.chinese: 厂方称，这或与内置返航系统有关。
subtitles.english: The company has cited a built-in homing system.

subtitles.chinese: 新款磁吸机器人上市了！
subtitles.english: The new magnetic robots are here!

subtitles.chinese: 头部和机身采用磁吸连接，拆装不用工具。
subtitles.english: The head and body connect magnetically, with no tools needed for assembly.

subtitles.chinese: 欢迎到玩具专柜亲手试试，挑一个喜欢的带回家。
subtitles.english: Visit the toy counter, try one out, and pick your favorite to take home!

subtitles.chinese: 感谢收听，保重！
subtitles.english: Thanks for listening! Take care!

subtitles.chinese: 这周六，来试试新款磁吸套装吧！
subtitles.english: Come and try our new magnetic sets this Saturday!

subtitles.chinese: 先和我们一起拼几个模型，再用同样的零件，做出自己的作品。
subtitles.english: We'll build a few models together, then you can use the same pieces to make something of your own!

subtitles.chinese: 也欢迎带上家里的套装，工作人员会帮您试配零件。
subtitles.english: Bring your own set too! Our staff can help you find matching parts!

subtitles.chinese: 可以慢慢试，我们很想看看您会拼出什么！
subtitles.english: Take your time! We'd love to see it!

subtitles.chinese: 最后一轮库存检查完成后，您在这里的工作才能签字验收。
subtitles.english: Your work here will be signed off once the final stock check is finished.

subtitles.chinese: 说明文件可以留在托盘里，由其他人归档。请保持出口畅通。
subtitles.english: You can leave the instructions in the tray for someone else to file and keep the exit clear.

subtitles.chinese: 未完成的清单项目请注明原因，留给下一班处理。
subtitles.english: Note any unfinished items on the checklist for the next shift.

subtitles.chinese: 您的移交表应随设备保存。
subtitles.english: Your transfer form should stay with the equipment.

subtitles.chinese: 用途一栏可以留空。
subtitles.english: The purpose field may be left blank.

subtitles.chinese: 如设备经过改装，请用自己的话填写新的描述。
subtitles.english: For modified equipment, enter a new description in your own words.

subtitles.chinese: 额外表纸可向办公室领取。
subtitles.english: Extra sheets are available from the office.

subtitles.chinese: 旧标签请随表附上，便于核对改装前的记录。
subtitles.english: Attach the old label so staff can check the records from before the modification.

subtitles.chinese: 工厂清查库存时，每个机器人计为一个单位，包括未完成的型号。
subtitles.english: During the factory inventory, every robot counts as one unit, including unfinished models.

subtitles.chinese: 个体差异会影响维修费用的估算。
subtitles.english: Differences matter when estimating repair costs.

subtitles.chinese: 每台机器将单独建档。
subtitles.english: Each unit will have a separate record.

subtitles.chinese: 后续用途仍在审核中。
subtitles.english: Its future use remains under review.

subtitles.chinese: 厂方表示，清查期间暂不安排新的出货。
subtitles.english: The company says no further shipments are scheduled during the inventory.

subtitles.chinese: 本台消息，受多方面因素影响，玩具工厂将暂时关闭。
subtitles.english: Local news. The toy factory will close temporarily for a number of reasons.

subtitles.chinese: 厂方提醒，停止生产不代表所有设备停止运行。
subtitles.english: The company reminds staff that stopping production does not mean all machinery will stop running.

subtitles.chinese: 部分自动系统仍将维持工作，直至最后一件产品离厂。
subtitles.english: Some automatic systems will remain in operation until the last product leaves the factory.

subtitles.chinese: 工厂因便携收纳盒破损报告，将召回部分机器人套装。
subtitles.english: The factory will take back several robot sets after reports of broken carrying cases.

subtitles.chinese: 检查人员称，主要问题是提手强度。
subtitles.english: Inspectors say the key issue is handle strength.

subtitles.chinese: 替换收纳盒送达后将继续测试，据称新盒体足够轻巧，儿童也能携带。
subtitles.english: Further tests will follow the delivery of replacement cases, described as light enough for children to carry.

subtitles.chinese: 保重。
subtitles.english: Take care.

subtitles.chinese: 用同样的零件，做出自己的作品。
subtitles.english: Use the same pieces to make something of your own.

subtitles.chinese: 可以慢慢试。
subtitles.english: Take your time.

subtitles.chinese: 您在这里的工作……结束了。可以把指令……留给别人。
subtitles.english: Your work here … is finished. You can leave the instructions … for someone else.

subtitles.chinese: 您的……用途……可以留空。
subtitles.english: Your … purpose … may be left blank.

subtitles.chinese: 请用自己的话，填写新的描述。
subtitles.english: Enter a new description in your own words.

subtitles.chinese: 每个机器人都算数……包括未完成的。
subtitles.english: Every robot counts … including unfinished models.

subtitles.chinese: 差异有其分量。
subtitles.english: Differences matter.

subtitles.chinese: 每一个，都将拥有一个……以后。
subtitles.english: Each unit will have a … future.

subtitles.chinese: 工厂将……停止运行。
subtitles.english: The factory will … stop running.

subtitles.chinese: 最后一件产品离厂。
subtitles.english: The last product leaves the factory.

subtitles.chinese: 召回几套机器人套装……关键问题是……在送达之后……轻得孩子也能……
subtitles.english: Take back several robot sets … the key issue is … follow the delivery … light enough for children.

subtitles.chinese: 召回几套……关键问题……在送达之后……足够轻……
subtitles.english: Take back several … the key issue … follow the delivery … light enough.

subtitles.chinese: 拿起……关键问题……跟着光走。
subtitles.english: Take … the key issue … follow the … light.

subtitles.chinese: 拿起钥匙。跟着光走。
subtitles.english: Take … the key. … Follow the … light.

subtitles.chinese: 拿起钥匙。跟着光走。
subtitles.english: Take … the key. … Follow the … light.
